title: Image morphing in mirror
content: Has anyone else had the experience of looking into a mirror in your dream? It's always normal at first but the longer I spend in front of the mirror, my image starts changing like getting scary. In one dream I was doing my makeup and then I noticed it looked like my makeup was peeling off so I rubbed it and my skin came off. I peeled off my face skin but there was just normal skin under it but my features looked kind of messed up. Another time I was looking in the mirror and then realized that's not what I look like, then got a panicky bad feeling and my face started morphing more and got scary looking. It's always okay if I'm quickly checking my reflection but if I stand too long in front of a mirror it gets weird.
